entries.source: Elite Stance. For 5…17…20 seconds, you move 33% faster and gain double adrenaline from attacks. Battle Rage ends if you use any non-adrenal skills.
entries.text: 精英態勢。持續 5…17…20 秒，移動速度提高 33%，並從攻擊中獲得雙倍怒氣。使用任何非怒氣技能時，戰鬥憤怒結束。
entries.reason: 依 Battle Rage 固定修訂逐句核對。Adrenaline 依中文詞典改為怒氣；保留僅攻擊所得加倍及非怒氣技能結束條件。

entries.source: Elite Pet Attack. Your animal companion attempts a Ferocious Strike that deals +13…25…28 damage. If that attack hits, you gain adrenaline and 3…9…10 Energy.
entries.text: 精英寵物攻擊。你的動物夥伴嘗試使出兇猛衝擊，造成 +13…25…28 點傷害。若攻擊命中，你獲得怒氣和 3…9…10 點能量。
entries.reason: 核對命中條件同時約束怒氣與能量獎勵。依詞典採怒氣，不增加英文未給出的怒氣數量。

entries.source: Elite Stance. For 1…7…8 seconds, you move 33% faster and have a 75% chance to block attacks.
entries.text: 精英態勢。持續 1…7…8 秒，移動速度提高 33%，並有 75% 機率格擋攻擊。
entries.reason: 格擋是戰鬥判定，不是阻止敵人發動攻擊；持續時間和兩項百分比均保留。

entries.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 5…15…17 seconds, target ally cannot be the target of enemy spells.
entries.text: 精英加持魔法。持續 5…15…17 秒，目標盟友無法成為敵方法術的目標。
entries.reason: 修正敵方法的漏字。效果限制敵方法術選定目標，未擴張為免疫全部傷害。

entries.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 5…11…13 seconds, target ally gains +3…9…10 Health regeneration and 20…40…45 armor.
entries.text: 精英加持魔法。持續 5…11…13 秒，目標盟友獲得 +3…9…10 體力再生和 20…40…45 點護甲。
entries.reason: 修正再生數值後的錯誤頓號；再生級數與護甲值保持獨立，未改成每秒等量治療。

entries.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 10 seconds, target other ally gains +3…5…6 Energy regeneration.
entries.text: 精英加持魔法。在 10 秒內，目標其他盟友獲得 +3…5…6 能量再生。
entries.reason: 逐句核對其他盟友排除自己、10 秒持續與 +3…5…6 能量再生。現譯保留限制與數值，維持原文。

entries.source: Elite Hex Spell. For 6…25…30 seconds, target foe and all nearby foes suffer -1…3…4 Health degeneration, and gain 25% less benefit from healing.
entries.text: 精英降咒魔法。持續 6…25…30 秒，目標敵人及附近所有敵人受到 -1…3…4 體力衰減，接受治療的效果降低 25%。
entries.reason: 核對 nearby 範圍與兩項同時效果。修正治療減益的語序，未改成只獲得 25% 治療。

entries.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 20…39…44 seconds, allies in the area are immune to disease, and anyone striking those allies in melee becomes Diseased for 3…13…15 seconds.
entries.text: 精英加持魔法。持續 20…39…44 秒，區域內的盟友免疫疾病。以近身攻擊命中這些盟友者會患上疾病，持續 3…13…15 秒。
entries.reason: 核對疾病免疫的對象及近身命中才反施病症的條件；兩個持續時間各自保留。

entries.source: Elite Stance. For 5…17…20 seconds, spells you cast recharge 33% faster.
entries.text: 精英態勢。持續 5…17…20 秒，你施放的法術冷卻速度提高 33%。
entries.reason: recharge 指法術冷卻而非充能或施法速度；保留態勢只影響法術的範圍。

entries.source: Elite Hex Spell. For 5…17…20 seconds, target moves and attacks 50% slower and suffers -1…7…8 Health degeneration.
entries.text: 精英降咒魔法。持續 5…17…20 秒，目標的移動與攻擊速度降低 50%，並受到 -1…7…8 體力衰減。
entries.reason: 核對降速同時影響移動和攻擊；修正原語序，未誤寫成降低至 50% 以外的幅度。

entries.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 30 seconds, Echo is replaced with the next skill you use. Echo acts as this skill for 30 seconds.
entries.text: 精英加持魔法。在 30 秒內，迴響會被你下一個使用的技能取代。迴響會以該技能的形式存在 30 秒。
entries.reason: 分開核對等待下一技能與複製技能存在的兩個 30 秒，不把複製理解為自動施放。Echo 有技能名與回音類型歧義，保留現有技能專名迴響。

entries.source: Elite Hex Spell. After 3 seconds, target foe is knocked down and struck for 14…83…100 lightning damage, and has Cracked Armor for 5…17…20 seconds. This spell has 25% armor penetration.
entries.text: 精英降咒魔法。3 秒後，目標敵人被擊倒，受到 14…83…100 點閃電傷害，並陷入碎甲 5…17…20 秒。此法術有 25% 護甲穿透。
entries.reason: Cracked Armor 為病症，修正破解防禦的動作誤譯。依現有病症正文採碎甲，保留延遲、傷害及穿透值。

entries.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 8…18…20 seconds, you gain +20 armor and cannot be the target of enemy spells, but cannot attack and have -2 energy degeneration.
entries.text: 精英加持魔法。持續 8…18…20 秒，你獲得 +20 護甲且無法成為敵方法術的目標，但無法攻擊，並受到 -2 能量衰減。
entries.reason: 修正敵方法的漏字與 energy degeneration 的退化誤譯。保留無法攻擊及 -2 能量衰減兩項代價。

entries.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 25…53…60 seconds, you are attuned to Air, Fire, Water, and Earth and gain +1…2…2 to these attributes. You gain 1 Energy plus 50% of the base Energy cost of the skill each time you use magic associated with any of these elements.
entries.text: 精英加持魔法。持續 25…53…60 秒，你與風、火、水、土元素協調，這些屬性提高 +1…2…2。每次使用與其中任一元素相關的魔法時，獲得 1 點能量，加上該技能基本能量消耗的 50%。
entries.reason: 核對四系屬性與返能公式。Air 是風系元素；返還以基本消耗計算，未把返能改成減費。

entries.source: Elite Hex Spell. Target foe takes 10…50…60 cold damage. If you have more Energy than target foe, that foe suffers an additional 10…50…60 cold damage and moves 90% slower for 1…4…5 seconds.
entries.text: 精英降咒魔法。目標敵人受到 10…50…60 點冰冷傷害。若你的能量高於目標敵人，該敵人額外受到 10…50…60 點冰冷傷害，並且移動速度降低 90%，持續 1…4…5 秒。
entries.reason: 核對能量比較同時約束額外傷害與減速；基礎傷害不受條件限制。修正 90% 減速語序。

entries.source: Elite Stance. For 1…6…7 seconds, you move 50% faster and if you strike a moving foe in melee, that foe is knocked down. Bull's Charge ends if you use a skill.
entries.text: 精英態勢。持續 1…6…7 秒，移動速度提高 50%；近身攻擊命中正在移動的敵人時，將其擊倒。使用技能時，此態勢結束。
entries.reason: 逐句核對近身命中移動敵人才擊倒，以及使用任何技能即結束態勢。現譯條件、1…6…7 秒及 50% 均完整，維持原文。

entries.source: Elite Stance. For 5…10…11 seconds, if you are wielding a hammer, you attack 33% faster, you gain +40 armor, and your attack skills interrupt foes when they hit.
entries.text: 精英態勢。持續 5…10…11 秒，持鎚時攻擊速度提高 33%，獲得 +40 護甲，且你的攻擊技能命中時會中斷敵人。
entries.reason: 逐句核對持鎚是攻速、護甲和命中中斷三項效果的前提。現譯保留全部條件與數值，維持原文。

entries.source: Elite Stance. For 5…10…11 seconds, you have a 75% chance to block incoming attacks. Whenever you block a melee attack this way, the attacker suffers 5…29…35 damage.
entries.text: 精英態勢。持續 5…10…11 秒，有 75% 機率格擋攻擊。每次以此方式格擋近身攻擊，攻擊者受到 5…29…35 點傷害。
entries.reason: 逐句核對一般攻擊的 75% 格擋與僅近身攻擊觸發反傷的差別。現譯 5…29…35 點傷害和持續時間正確，維持原文。

entries.source: Elite Stance. For 8…18…20 seconds, you gain +4 Health regeneration and +1 Energy regeneration for each condition and hex you are suffering.
entries.text: 精英態勢。持續 8…18…20 秒，你每受到一種病症或降咒影響，就獲得 +4 體力再生和 +1 能量再生。
entries.reason: 逐句核對每種病症及降咒都各增加 +4 體力再生與 +1 能量再生。現譯保持再生概念及 8…18…20 秒，維持原文。

entries.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. Target ally loses 0…7…9 conditions and hex[es]. For 1…3…3 seconds, conditions and hexes expire 90% faster on that ally. All your Smiting Prayers are disabled for 20 seconds.
entries.text: 精英加持魔法。移除目標盟友身上的 0…7…9 項病症和降咒。持續 1…3…3 秒，該盟友身上的病症和降咒消退速度提高 90%。你的所有懲戒祈禱技能被停用 20 秒。
entries.reason: 逐句核對移除數量、90% 加速消退及懲戒祈禱停用 20 秒。病症和降咒未混同加持，維持原文。

entries.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. While you maintain this enchantment, your Monk spells heal for +15…51…60% more Health. When this enchantment ends one random other party member is resurrected with full Health and Energy and teleported to your location.
entries.text: 精英加持魔法。維持期間，你的僧侶法術治療量提高 +15…51…60%。此加持結束時，隨機一名其他隊伍成員以滿體力和滿能量復活，並傳送到你所在的位置。
entries.reason: 逐句核對維持加持的治療增幅，及結束時隨機復活其他隊伍成員。滿體力、滿能量和傳送位置皆完整，維持原文。

entries.source: Elite Spell. Remove all conditions (Poison, Disease, Blindness, Dazed, Bleeding, Crippled, Burning, Weakness, Cracked Armor, and Deep Wound) from target other ally. For each condition removed, that ally is healed for 10…58…70 Health.
entries.text: 精英咒文。移除目標其他盟友的所有病症，包括中毒、疾病、失明、暈眩、流血、殘廢、燃燒、虛弱、碎甲和重傷。每移除一種病症，該盟友恢復 10…58…70 點體力。
entries.reason: 逐項比對十種病症及每移除一種的治療值。目標其他盟友不包含自己，病症清單和 10…58…70 均正確，維持原文。

entries.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 5 seconds, whenever a party member who is not under the effects of another Necromancer enchantment hits a foe with physical damage, that party member steals up to 3…13…16 Health.
entries.text: 精英加持魔法。持續 5 秒，未受其他死靈法師加持影響的隊伍成員對敵人造成物理傷害時，竊取最多 3…13…16 點體力。
entries.reason: 逐句核對非其他死靈法師加持、物理傷害命中與最多竊取體力。現譯未擴張至所有盟友或全部傷害，維持原文。

entries.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 30 seconds, your melee attacks neither hit nor fail to hit. Instead, Illusionary Weaponry deals 20…52…60 damage to your targets for each melee attack. You have +5 armor for each equipped Illusion Magic skill.
entries.text: 精英加持魔法。持續 30 秒，你的近身攻擊既不判定為命中，也不判定為未命中；每次近身攻擊改為對目標造成 20…52…60 點傷害。每裝備一個幻術魔法技能，獲得 +5 護甲。
entries.reason: 逐句核對既非命中也非未命中的特殊判定，以及每裝備幻術魔法技能 +5 護甲。現譯保留特殊機制，維持原文。

entries.source: Elite Hex Spell. For 10 seconds, target foe and all foes adjacent to your target take 5…21…25 damage each second. Foes using attack skills are Blinded for 3 seconds. This hex ends if you use a skill that targets this foe.
entries.text: 精英降咒魔法。持續 10 秒，目標敵人及其所有鄰近敵人每秒受到 5…21…25 點傷害。使用攻擊技能的敵人會失明 3 秒。若你使用以該敵人為目標的技能，此降咒結束。
entries.reason: 依 Glimmering Mark 固定修訂，hex 是降咒而非十六進位制。保留鄰近範圍、攻擊技能觸發失明及選定目標即結束的條件。

entries.source: Elite Item Spell. Hold Kuurong's ashes for up to 15…51…60 seconds. When you drop his ashes, all foes in the area are struck for 15…63…75 damage and knocked down.
entries.text: 精英抱持魔法。手持 Kuurong 的骨灰，最多持續 15…51…60 秒。放下骨灰時，區域內所有敵人受到 15…63…75 點傷害並被擊倒。
entries.reason: 依物品魔法編輯詞典修正類型與 hold 動作。保留區域範圍及放下才觸發效果；未確定的骨灰持有人名稱保留英文。 第二輪依固定中文種類欄（反抗軍欣雷17519@28259、復仇者漢何17522@27618）對齊類型名稱。

entries.source: Elite Item Spell. Hold Xinrae's ashes for up to 15…51…60 seconds. While you hold her ashes, you cannot lose more than 20% of your max Health from a single hit. When you drop her ashes, you steal 5…41…50 Health from all nearby foes.
entries.text: 精英抱持魔法。手持 Xinrae 的骨灰，最多持續 15…51…60 秒。持有期間，單次命中使你損失的體力不會超過最大體力的 20%。放下骨灰時，從附近所有敵人身上竊取 5…41…50 點體力。
entries.reason: 依 Defiant Was Xinrae 固定修訂補回最大體力的 20% 上限。區分持有減傷和放下竊取體力，保持 nearby 範圍。 第二輪依固定中文種類欄（反抗軍欣雷17519@28259、復仇者漢何17522@27618）對齊類型名稱。

entries.source: Elite Weapon Spell. For 5…21…25 seconds, target ally has a Weapon of Quickening, and spells and binding rituals recharge 33% faster.
entries.text: 精英武裝魔法。持續 5…21…25 秒，目標盟友獲得復甦武裝，其法術與縛靈儀式的冷卻速度提高 33%。
entries.reason: 依編輯詞典使用武裝魔法、縛靈儀式。效果是冷卻加快，並非充能或減少施法時間；復甦武裝沿用中文來源。

entries.source: Elite Weapon Spell. For 10 seconds, target ally gains 5…21…25 Health per second and an additional 5…21…25 Health per second if that ally is within earshot of a spirit.
entries.text: 精英武裝魔法。持續 10 秒，目標盟友每秒恢復 5…21…25 點體力。若該盟友位於精魂的音量所及範圍內，每秒額外恢復 5…21…25 點體力。
entries.reason: 逐句核對每秒治療而非體力再生級數，額外治療取決於盟友與精魂距離。兩組治療值和持續時間保留。

entries.source: Elite Item Spell. Hold Tanasen's ashes for up to 5…17…20 seconds. While you hold his ashes, you have +10…22…25 armor and cannot be interrupted.
entries.text: 精英抱持魔法。手持 Tanasen 的骨灰，最多持續 5…17…20 秒。持有期間，你獲得 +10…22…25 護甲且不會被中斷。
entries.reason: 核對持有物品期間才有護甲和免中斷效果。沿用物品魔法類型，未確定的持有人專名保留英文。 第二輪依固定中文種類欄（反抗軍欣雷17519@28259、復仇者漢何17522@27618）對齊類型名稱。

entries.source: Elite Item Spell. Hold Khanhei's ashes for 5…10…11 seconds. Whenever a foe strikes you in combat while you are holding Khanhei's ashes, you steal 10…38…45 Health from that foe.
entries.text: 精英抱持魔法。手持 Khanhei 的骨灰，持續 5…10…11 秒。持有期間，每當敵人在戰鬥中命中你，你就從該敵人身上竊取 10…38…45 點體力。
entries.reason: strikes 指命中而非僅發動攻擊；修正觸發時機。保留竊取對象為該命中者，未把骨灰效果改成放下觸發。 第二輪依固定中文種類欄（反抗軍欣雷17519@28259、復仇者漢何17522@27618）對齊類型名稱。

entries.source: Elite Item Spell. Hold Songkai's ashes for up to 45 seconds. While you hold her ashes, your spells and binding rituals cost -5…41…50% of the base Energy to cast.
entries.text: 精英抱持魔法。手持 Songkai 的骨灰，最多持續 45 秒。持有期間，你的法術和縛靈儀式的能量消耗降低基本消耗的 5…41…50%。
entries.reason: cost -5…41…50% 指按基本消耗減費，原譯誤成支付負數能量；負號以降低表達，減費數值不變。採物品魔法、縛靈儀式；專名保持英文以免臆造。 第二輪依固定中文種類欄（反抗軍欣雷17519@28259、復仇者漢何17522@27618）對齊類型名稱。

entries.source:
* The fight is made difficult by the large number of both Grawl Champions and Grawl Dark Priests which surround him. Approaching him from the south, four of the closest Grawl Champions can be pulled away from the group, but all the others attack cohesively along with the boss.
* Area-of-effect anti-melee hexes such as Meekness and Enfeebling Blood are very useful, along with wards such as Ward Against Melee and Ebon Battle Standard of Courage. As always, a minion master can greatly help redirect damage from the team.
entries.text:
* 周圍的大量穴居人勇士（Grawl Champions）和穴居人黑暗牧師使戰鬥更加困難。從南方接近時，可以把最近的四名穴居人勇士從敵群中引開，其餘敵人則會與首領一同攻擊。
* 溫順、血之衰弱等範圍反近身攻擊降咒，以及迴避結界、黑檀勇氣戰旗（Ebon Battle Standard of Courage）等防護區域效果都很有用。召喚死靈僕從的角色也能大幅分擔隊伍承受的傷害。
entries.reason: 依 Cobleri Arronn 固定修訂，wards 是結界而非病房，minion master 指以僕從分擔傷害的角色。保留南方拉四名敵人的策略及未確定技能的英文名。

entries.source: Keys and lockpicks drop at four times the usual rate and double Lucky and Unlucky title points
entries.text: 鑰匙和開鎖器的掉落率提高至平常的四倍，幸運與不幸頭銜點數加倍。
entries.reason: 核對四倍只修飾掉落率，雙倍修飾兩種頭銜點數；沒有把 and 誤成二選一。已對照 Weekly bonuses 固定修訂。

entries.source: Double Sunspear and Lightbringer points
entries.text: 日戟（Sunspear）與光明（Lightbringer）點數加倍。
entries.reason: 修正雙陽陽之矛的重字與概念誤譯。依 rank 詞典保留日戟和光明，附英文避免混淆。已對照 Weekly bonuses 固定修訂。

entries.source: Double copper Zaishen Coin rewards for Zaishen bounties
entries.text: 戰承懸賞的戰承銅幣獎勵加倍。
entries.reason: 只加倍 Copper Zaishen Coin，不擴張為經驗、金錢或全部任務獎勵。已對照 Weekly bonuses 固定修訂。

entries.source: The Deep and Urgoz's Warren can be entered from Kaineng Center
entries.text: 可從凱寧中心進入深處與爾果的養殖場。
entries.reason: entered 是進入地圖而非輸入文字；沿用中文詞典的兩個精英任務名稱。已對照 Weekly bonuses 固定修訂。

entries.source: Double Asura, Deldrimor, Ebon Vanguard, or Norn reputation points
entries.text: 阿蘇拉、戴爾狄摩、黑檀先鋒隊或諾恩的名聲點數加倍。
entries.reason: 核對四個名聲軌道；Ebon Vanguard rank 依詞典補完整為黑檀先鋒隊，未改成陣營值。已對照 Weekly bonuses 固定修訂。

entries.source: Double copper Zaishen Coin rewards for Zaishen missions
entries.text: 戰承主線任務的戰承銅幣獎勵加倍。
entries.reason: Mission 依詞典區別主線任務。加倍範圍限銅幣，不誤稱全部獎勵加倍。已對照 Weekly bonuses 固定修訂。

entries.source: Free passage to the Underworld and the Fissure of Woe
entries.text: 免費進入地下世界（Underworld）與災難裂痕（Fissure of Woe）。
entries.reason: Free passage 指免入場費，不是自由通行。採中文詞典地名並保留英文，未擴張為免除入場條件。已對照 Weekly bonuses 固定修訂。

entries.source: Double Kurzick and Luxon title track points for exchanging faction
entries.text: 以陣營值兌換時，獲得的庫茲柯與勒克森頭銜點數加倍。
entries.reason: title track 是頭銜進度，非標題曲目。加倍發生在兌換陣營值時，不是取得陣營值時。已對照 Weekly bonuses 固定修訂。

entries.source: Double copper Zaishen Coin rewards for Zaishen vanquishes
entries.text: 戰承清圖任務的戰承銅幣獎勵加倍。
entries.reason: 區別清圖完成獎勵與普通殺敵收益；翻倍項目僅 Copper Zaishen Coin。已對照 Weekly bonuses 固定修訂。

entries.source: Double Balthazar faction and Gladiator title points in Random Arenas
entries.text: 隨機競技場的巴薩澤陣營值與鬥士頭銜點數加倍。
entries.reason: 核對兩種獨立收益；Gladiator 沿用詞典鬥士，title points 譯為頭銜點數。已對照 Weekly bonuses 固定修訂。

entries.source: Double Balthazar faction and Champion title points in GvG
entries.text: 公會戰的巴薩澤陣營值與勇士頭銜點數加倍。
entries.reason: Champion 依中文詞典的公會戰頭銜義。保留 GvG 場景，不把頭銜當職業或 NPC。已對照 Weekly bonuses 固定修訂。

entries.source: Double Balthazar and Imperial faction in the Jade Quarry and Fort Aspenwood
entries.text: 翡翠礦場與楊木要塞的巴薩澤陣營值及帝國值加倍。
entries.reason: 核對雙倍作用於兩地的兩種 faction；修正雙巴薩澤及省略陣營值造成的歧義。已對照 Weekly bonuses 固定修訂。

entries.source: Double Balthazar faction and Hero title points in Heroes' Ascent
entries.text: 英雄之路的巴薩澤陣營值與英雄頭銜點數加倍。
entries.reason: 核對 Hero 為頭銜而非角色單位，收益限 Heroes’ Ascent；保持兩類收益加倍。已對照 Weekly bonuses 固定修訂。

entries.source: Double Balthazar faction and Codex title points in Codex Arena
entries.text: Codex Arena 的巴薩澤陣營值與 Codex 頭銜點數加倍。
entries.reason: 中文詞典未確立 Codex Arena 專名，保留英文；title points 修正為頭銜點數。已對照 Weekly bonuses 固定修訂。

entries.source: Double Balthazar and Imperial faction in Alliance Battles
entries.text: 同盟戰的巴薩澤陣營值與帝國值加倍。
entries.reason: 核對 Alliance Battles 場景與兩類 faction。補回原譯省略的陣營值，未擴張至頭銜點數。已對照 Weekly bonuses 固定修訂。

entries.source: Regular weekly rotation. Festivals or temporary official events may add other effects.
entries.text: 每週定期輪換。節慶或臨時官方活動可能會增加其他影響。
entries.reason: 逐句核對這是每週常規輪換，節慶及官方臨時活動另加效果。現譯保留例外與非保證語氣，維持原文。

entries.source: Predicted from the cited rotation; this offline application does not read live game announcements.
entries.text: 根據引用的輪換預測；此離線應用程式不讀取即時遊戲公告。
entries.reason: 逐句核對離線預測依引用輪換，且不讀取即時公告。現譯未宣稱即時官方資訊，維持原文。

entries.source:
As per the Augury Rock mission.
The mission doesn't need to be a success. Defeating the Doppelganger is enough to complete the quest; however, the first bonus is not satisfied if you die before the Doppelganger.
The completion record belongs to the rotation in which the quest was accepted. It does not change permanent skill or vanquishing progress.
entries.text:
參照占卜之石主線任務。
主線任務不必成功；擊敗分身即可完成這項任務。但若你先於分身死亡，便不符合第一項額外目標。
完成記錄歸屬於接取任務時的輪換，不會改變永久的技能或清圖進度。
entries.reason: 核對完成條件和額外目標不同；保留先死亡失去第一項額外獎勵的條件。另核對輪換記錄與永久進度分離。

entries.source:
As per the Blacktide Den mission.
*In order to receive credit for the first bonus objective, you must complete the mission.
The completion record belongs to the rotation in which the quest was accepted. It does not change permanent skill or vanquishing progress.
entries.text:
參照黑潮巢穴主線任務。
* 必須完成主線任務，才計入第一項額外目標。
完成記錄歸屬於接取任務時的輪換，不會改變永久的技能或清圖進度。
entries.reason: 核對主線成功是取得第一項額外目標的必要條件，未誤成一般積分。另核對輪換記錄與永久進度分離。

entries.source:
As per the Divinity Coast mission.
* It might be easier to complete the first bonus objective in normal mode, since the five Chosen can die more quickly in hard mode.
The completion record belongs to the rotation in which the quest was accepted. It does not change permanent skill or vanquishing progress.
entries.text:
參照神聖海岸主線任務。
* 第一項額外目標在普通模式下較容易完成，因為五名選民在困難模式下更容易死亡。
完成記錄歸屬於接取任務時的輪換，不會改變永久的技能或清圖進度。
entries.reason: 核對普通模式建議的原因是五名護送對象的生存，不是更快擊殺敵人。另核對輪換記錄與永久進度分離。

entries.source:
As per the Ring of Fire mission.
Contrary to the quest objective text and the mission bonus, killing the Eidolon is counted as completion, rather than returning the Spectral Essence.
The completion record belongs to the rotation in which the quest was accepted. It does not change permanent skill or vanquishing progress.
entries.text:
參照火環群島主線任務。
與任務目標文字及主線額外目標不同，擊殺 Eidolon 即計為完成，不必交回 Spectral Essence。
完成記錄歸屬於接取任務時的輪換，不會改變永久的技能或清圖進度。
entries.reason: 原譯殘留模板並把 returning 誤寫。保留擊殺即完成、無須交回物品的例外；未確定物品專名保留英文。另核對輪換記錄與永久進度分離。

entries.source:
As per the Nahpui Quarter mission.
To complete the first bonus objective, you must complete the mission within 40 minutes in Hard Mode or 25 minutes in Normal Mode. It may be that the text should read "complete the mission and attain the Master's Reward" rather than give a fixed time frame.
The completion record belongs to the rotation in which the quest was accepted. It does not change permanent skill or vanquishing progress.
entries.text:
參照納普區主線任務。
第一項額外目標要求在困難模式 40 分鐘內，或普通模式 25 分鐘內完成主線任務。原說明可能應寫成「完成主線任務並取得大師級獎勵（Master’s Reward）」，而非列出固定時限。
完成記錄歸屬於接取任務時的輪換，不會改變永久的技能或清圖進度。
entries.reason: 核對兩種模式的不同時限及來源對目標文字的保留疑問，不把推測寫成確定規則。另核對輪換記錄與永久進度分離。

entries.source:
As per the Borlis Pass mission.
The 2 Frostfire Dryders that accompany the Ice Drake also have to be killed to complete the first bonus objective.
The completion record belongs to the rotation in which the quest was accepted. It does not change permanent skill or vanquishing progress.
entries.text:
參照柏里斯通道主線任務。
要完成第一項額外目標，還必須擊殺伴隨冰龍獸的 2 隻霜火蛛化精靈。
完成記錄歸屬於接取任務時的輪換，不會改變永久的技能或清圖進度。
entries.reason: Dryders 依中文詞典為蛛化精靈，非烘乾機；保留 2 隻與必須同時擊殺條件。另核對輪換記錄與永久進度分離。

entries.source:
As per The Elusive Golemancer quest.
*Although the objectives states this as a mission, it is actually a primary quest.
*The mission objectives say the laboratory is to the south of Rata Sum. It is actually to the west.
The completion record belongs to the rotation in which the quest was accepted. It does not change permanent skill or vanquishing progress.
entries.text:
參照 The Elusive Golemancer 任務。
* 目標文字把它稱作主線任務（mission），實際上它是主要任務（primary quest）。
* 任務目標稱實驗室位於洛達頂點南方，實際位置在西方。
完成記錄歸屬於接取任務時的輪換，不會改變永久的技能或清圖進度。
entries.reason: 英文區分 mission 與 primary quest，原譯把兩者混成任務。保留任務英文身份及南方誤標、西方實際方向。另核對輪換記錄與永久進度分離。

entries.source:
As per the Riverside Province mission.
*It is significantly easier and faster to complete the mission in hard mode and then do the first bonus in normal mode (assuming you don't need the hard mode bonus for the Guardian of Tyria title).
The completion record belongs to the rotation in which the quest was accepted. It does not change permanent skill or vanquishing progress.
entries.text:
參照河畔地帶主線任務。
* 先在困難模式完成主線，再到普通模式完成第一項額外目標，會明顯更容易且更快；前提是你不需要為泰瑞亞守護者（Guardian of Tyria）頭銜完成困難模式的額外目標。
完成記錄歸屬於接取任務時的輪換，不會改變永久的技能或清圖進度。
entries.reason: 核對兩次不同模式的完成次序與頭銜例外。原譯把 Guardian of Tyria 拆成守護者或泰瑞亞，已修正。另核對輪換記錄與永久進度分離。

entries.source:
As per the Sunjiang District mission.
*Similar to its Master's Reward, the mission can be completed in under 25 minutes in hard mode for this quest's first bonus objective.
The completion record belongs to the rotation in which the quest was accepted. It does not change permanent skill or vanquishing progress.
entries.text:
參照孫江行政區主線任務。
* 與大師級獎勵（Master’s Reward）的條件相同，在困難模式下用時少於 25 分鐘完成主線任務，即可完成這項任務的第一項額外目標。
完成記錄歸屬於接取任務時的輪換，不會改變永久的技能或清圖進度。
entries.reason: Master’s Reward 是完成評級而非主人的任務獎勵；under 25 minutes 保留少於 25 分鐘。另核對輪換記錄與永久進度分離。

entries.source:
As per the Veiled Threat quest. At least one party member must have the quest.

The completion record belongs to the rotation in which the quest was accepted. It does not change permanent skill or vanquishing progress.
entries.text:
參照隱藏的威脅任務。至少一名隊伍成員必須接有該任務。

完成記錄歸屬於接取任務時的輪換，不會改變永久的技能或清圖進度。
entries.reason: party member 是隊伍成員而非黨員；have the quest 表示持有任務，未改成已完成。另核對輪換記錄與永久進度分離。

entries.source:
As per the Watch it Jiggle quest. At least one party member must have the quest in order to get past the locked gate in the dungeon.

The completion record belongs to the rotation in which the quest was accepted. It does not change permanent skill or vanquishing progress.
entries.text:
參照 Watch it Jiggle 任務。至少一名隊伍成員必須接有該任務，才能通過地城內上鎖的大門。

完成記錄歸屬於接取任務時的輪換，不會改變永久的技能或清圖進度。
entries.reason: 依 Prismatic Ooze 固定修訂，have the quest 是接有任務，原譯已完成會阻斷進入。未確定的任務專名保留英文。另核對輪換記錄與永久進度分離。

entries.source:
As per The Last Hierophant quest.
*To gain access to Duncan's dungeon, all party members have to have killed the preceding four bosses Justiciar Thommis, Rand Stormweaver, Selvetarm and Forgewight as shown in The Last Hierophant quest. The 4 "defeat" lines must be crossed off leaving only "Destroy Duncan the Black" left undone. This situation is frequently abbreviated "4/5."
The completion record belongs to the rotation in which the quest was accepted. It does not change permanent skill or vanquishing progress.
entries.text:
參照最後的聖職者任務。
* 要進入鄧肯的地城，所有隊伍成員都必須已擊殺前四名首領：司法官湯米茲、織暴者硬皮、希維塔姆和煉冶維特。最後的聖職者任務中的 4 行「擊敗」目標須已劃除，只剩「消滅黑色鄧肯（Destroy Duncan the Black）」尚未完成。這個狀態常簡稱為「4/5」。
完成記錄歸屬於接取任務時的輪換，不會改變永久的技能或清圖進度。
entries.reason: defeat 目標指擊敗而非失敗。核對所有隊員均須前四王完成、鄧肯未完成的 4/5 條件。另核對輪換記錄與永久進度分離。

entries.source:
He appears in Heart of the Shiverpeaks on your character's second trip through. Your character must have completed the Heart of the Shiverpeaks quest to reach Magmus. Make sure no one in your party has that quest active, or Cyndr the Mountain Heart will spawn instead.

The completion record belongs to the rotation in which the quest was accepted. It does not change permanent skill or vanquishing progress.
entries.text:
角色第二次進入席娃山脈之心時，他才會出現。該角色必須已完成席娃山脈之心任務，才能抵達麥格默斯。確認隊伍中無人仍接有該任務，否則出現的會是山之心辛德爾。

完成記錄歸屬於接取任務時的輪換，不會改變永久的技能或清圖進度。
entries.reason: 核對角色已完成與隊伍任何人仍接有任務的兩項不同限制；active 並非啟動遊戲功能。另核對輪換記錄與永久進度分離。

entries.source:
As per Justiciar Thommis' level. Both Rand Stormweaver and the small group directly around him must be killed.

The completion record belongs to the rotation in which the quest was accepted. It does not change permanent skill or vanquishing progress.
entries.text:
路線參照司法官湯米茲所在的地城樓層。必須擊殺織暴者硬皮，以及緊鄰他的整支小隊。

完成記錄歸屬於接取任務時的輪換，不會改變永久的技能或清圖進度。
entries.reason: level 在此是地城樓層，非角色等級。保留首領與周圍小隊都要擊殺的雙重條件。另核對輪換記錄與永久進度分離。

entries.source:
Despite the objective description, this quest does not require killing 25 foes, but requires vanquishing the area. The quest is still completed if the area is vanquished by killing less than 25 foes. See Bukdek Byway#Notes for details on 0-kill or low-count vanquishes.
The completion record belongs to the rotation in which the quest was accepted. It does not change permanent skill or vanquishing progress.
entries.text:
任務目標文字雖提及擊殺 25 名敵人，實際條件是完成該區域的清圖。即使擊殺少於 25 名敵人，只要清圖完成仍可完成任務。0 擊殺或低擊殺數清圖的細節，參閱 Bukdek Byway#Notes。
完成記錄歸屬於接取任務時的輪換，不會改變永久的技能或清圖進度。
entries.reason: 區別殺敵數與清圖完成狀態，保留來源指出的目標文字錯誤及 0 擊殺例外。另核對輪換記錄與永久進度分離。

entries.source:
* Unlike other Zaishen Vanquish quests that require vanquishing areas in Vabbi, this quest awards 3,500 Sunspear Promotion Points instead of 750.
The completion record belongs to the rotation in which the quest was accepted. It does not change permanent skill or vanquishing progress.
entries.text:
* 其他要求在瓦貝清圖的戰承任務通常給予 750 點日戟晉升點數（Sunspear Promotion Points）；這項任務給予 3,500 點。
完成記錄歸屬於接取任務時的輪換，不會改變永久的技能或清圖進度。
entries.reason: 核對獎勵為日戟而非光明，並保持 3,500 對 750 的例外比較。日戟沿用 rank 詞典並保留英文。另核對輪換記錄與永久進度分離。

entries.source:
* Prophecies characters who have not completed The Ascalon Settlement can have Mhenlo, Cynn, Devona, and Aidan help vanquish the area. (They will be level 20 but possess no elite skills.)
The completion record belongs to the rotation in which the quest was accepted. It does not change permanent skill or vanquishing progress.
entries.text:
* 尚未完成阿斯卡隆移民區任務的阿斯卡隆戰記角色，可以讓涵洛、莘、德佛娜和艾登協助清圖。他們均為 20 級，但沒有精英技能。
完成記錄歸屬於接取任務時的輪換，不會改變永久的技能或清圖進度。
entries.reason: 核對僅未完成該任務的 Prophecies 角色符合條件；四名同行者等級與無精英技能限制均保留。另核對輪換記錄與永久進度分離。

entries.source:
*Consider waiting for two and three more days to acquire the quests for Skyward Reach and The Scar, respectively, since you can caravan vanquish all three areas consecutively with an eight-member party via Forgotten Guardian.
The completion record belongs to the rotation in which the quest was accepted. It does not change permanent skill or vanquishing progress.
entries.text:
* 可考慮再等兩天與三天，分別接取天際流域及斷崖任務，再經由 Forgotten Guardian 帶領八人隊伍連續完成這三個區域的清圖。
完成記錄歸屬於接取任務時的輪換，不會改變永久的技能或清圖進度。
entries.reason: 核對分別等待 2、3 天與對應任務順序；caravan vanquish 表示隊伍連續清圖，未把 NPC 當隊員。另核對輪換記錄與永久進度分離。

entries.source:
*Consider acquiring the quests for The Arid Sea (two days earlier) and The Scar (the next quest in cycle), since you can caravan vanquish all three areas consecutively with an eight-member party via Forgotten Guardian.
The completion record belongs to the rotation in which the quest was accepted. It does not change permanent skill or vanquishing progress.
entries.text:
* 可考慮同時接取枯竭之海（兩天前輪到）和斷崖（輪換中的下一項）任務，再經由 Forgotten Guardian 帶領八人隊伍連續完成這三個區域的清圖。
完成記錄歸屬於接取任務時的輪換，不會改變永久的技能或清圖進度。
entries.reason: 核對枯竭之海是兩天前而非再等兩天，斷崖是下一輪換項目；保留八人連續清圖條件。另核對輪換記錄與永久進度分離。

entries.source:
*Consider acquiring the quests for The Arid Sea (three days earlier) and Skyward Reach (the prior quest in cycle), since you can caravan vanquish all three areas consecutively with an eight-member party via Forgotten Guardian.
The completion record belongs to the rotation in which the quest was accepted. It does not change permanent skill or vanquishing progress.
entries.text:
* 可考慮同時接取枯竭之海（三天前輪到）和天際流域（輪換中的上一項）任務，再經由 Forgotten Guardian 帶領八人隊伍連續完成這三個區域的清圖。
完成記錄歸屬於接取任務時的輪換，不會改變永久的技能或清圖進度。

entries.source:
*Nicholas sometimes fails to appear in his expected location:
**Active quests can alter spawns in the area. To fix this, complete or abandon the local quests before returning. Alternatively, visit the area with a different character without the relevant quests.
**Some areas have variable spawns (e.g. Pockmark Flats); rezoning a few times will address this.
**He has sometimes failed to spawn due to the War in Kryta (e.g. in Kessex Peak (War in Kryta)); if not previously fixed by ArenaNet, you can work around this by using a character who has not started WiK or dropping any relevant bounties for characters that have finished WiK.
**Winds of Change might have a similar effect. For example, for the week of Putrid Cysts, you must not have Winds of Change active. To temporarily undo Winds of Change, take Memories of Purity from the Herald of Purity in Kaineng Center (requires completion of Cleansing Morostav Trail).
*Nicholas does not exchange items for gifts in two situations:
**If you enter an area before Nick's scheduled move time, but do not reach him until afterward, Nick will not speak to you at all.
**He attends The Wedding as a guest of Gwen, but not as a collector.
*Nicholas has occasionally been found facing a random object, obstructive landscape, or a wall.
*Nicksets are commonly traded in Kamadan or near the outpost where Nicholas is currently located. A nickset represents the exact quantity of an item required to obtain all 5 weekly Gifts of the Traveler. For example, if Nicholas requires 3 of an item per gift, a nickset consists of 15 of that item (3 × 5).
**Trading nicksets is generally beneficial for the buyer, as 5 Gifts of the Traveler are typically worth more than the nickset itself. The seller benefits from the convenience of not having to locate Nicholas in an explorable area. Note that prices are subject to fluctuation and may reach a point where Gifts of the Traveler are worth less than a nickset, making the trade unfavorable for the buyer.
Sometimes his greeting and/or reward text is not translated into one or more non-English languages. Please report any issues at the localization bug feedback pages so that they can be quickly resolved.

entries.text:
* 尼可拉斯有時不會出現在預定位置：
** 已接取的任務會改變區域內 NPC 的出現。先完成或放棄當地任務再返回，或改用未接取相關任務的其他角色前往。
** 有些區域的出現配置會變動，例如麻點平原；反覆進出區域幾次即可處理。
** 科瑞塔戰爭有時會阻止他出現，例如凱席斯山峰（科瑞塔戰爭）。若 ArenaNet 尚未修正，可改用未開始科瑞塔戰爭的角色；已完成的角色則可放棄相關懸賞。
** 變幻之風也可能有類似影響。例如收集 Putrid Cysts 的那一週，不可處於變幻之風的活動狀態。要暫時取消其區域影響，可向凱寧中心的 Herald of Purity 接取 Memories of Purity；前提是已完成 Cleansing Morostav Trail。
* 尼可拉斯在兩種情況下不會交換禮物：
** 在預定移動時間前進入區域，但移動時間過後才抵達他身邊時，他完全不會與你交談。
** 他在 The Wedding 中是 Gwen 的賓客，並非收藏家。
* 尼可拉斯偶爾會面向隨機物件、阻擋視線的地形或牆壁。
* 玩家常在卡馬丹或尼可拉斯目前位置附近的前哨站交易 nickset。nickset 指兌換當週全部 5 份旅行者禮物所需的完整材料量。例如每份禮物要 3 個材料，一套就是 15 個（3 × 5）。
** 通常買方能受益，因為 5 份旅行者禮物的價值高於一套材料；賣方則省去在可探索區域尋找尼可拉斯的時間。不過價格會波動，禮物總值也可能低於材料套組，使買方交易不利。
他的招呼或獎勵對話有時缺少一種或多種非英文翻譯。可到本地化錯誤回報頁面反映問題，讓問題盡快獲得修正。
